interface.shortDescription: Outcome-first AI toolkit: requirements, architecture, craft, and quality
interface.longDescription: FIS AI Kit delivers outcome-first AI assistance for software teams. Start with /fis:outcome to capture goals and acceptance criteria, then use /fis:requirements, /fis:architecture, /fis:craft, and /fis:test as your work progresses. Works for greenfield, brownfield, and domain-specific contexts without mandating role boundaries or approval gates.
defaultPrompt: Start with /fis:outcome to define what success looks like for this feature.
Use /fis:requirements to capture and refine what needs to be built.
Use /fis:architecture to design the implementation approach.
